study type: Mixed-methods (case-note review, structured observations, qualitative interviews)
exposure: barriers and facilitators to SDM implementation
outcome: offered choice in relation to timing or mode of birth
experiences of women making decisions about childbirth
cohort: Pregnant women with chronic hypertension, some with superimposed pre-eclampsia, and their principal carers at three National Health Service hospital trusts.
finding: Despite frequent caesarean sections and early term births, pregnant women with chronic hypertension were not regularly provided with personalized information or offered choice regarding timing or mode of birth, with uncertainty regarding optimal timing being a main barrier.
mod_finding: Despite frequent caesarean section births (52%), pregnant women were not regularly offered choice in relation to mode of birth.
cross-section timing: During third trimester antenatal care, leading up to birth planning
gest_age: Median gestation at delivery 38 weeks (IQR1 37 weeks, IQR3 39 weeks)
